# West Coast Capital Mortgage: investment property loans (full text)

> Investment property loans for real estate investors and developers in California, Florida and Texas from West Coast Capital Mortgage (150 E Olive Ave, Unit 112, Burbank, CA 91502; NMLS #2817729; CA DRE Corporation License #02440065). Figures are program maximums; not a commitment to lend.

Site summary and other sections: https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/llms.txt

## Financing for Real Estate Investors & Developers
URL: https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/investor-loans

Fix and flip, construction, bridge and rental loans in California, Florida and Texas: our term sheet, our team and our borrower portal, with our private lender behind every loan.

Questions and answers:
Q: What investor loans do you offer?
A: Fix and flip, ground-up construction, bridge, DSCR, rental portfolio and multifamily bridge loans for investors in California, Florida and Texas, closed in your LLC or corporation.

Q: How much can I borrow?
A: Up to 90% of the price plus 100% of the rehab on a fix and flip, 75% of the land plus 100% of construction on a new build, up to 80% LTV on rentals, and $2M to $5M on apartment buildings.

Q: Will you finance my first flip?
A: Yes. First-time investors can get up to 90% of the price plus 100% of the rehab, depending on credit and the project.

Q: Do you verify my personal income?
A: No. Rental loans qualify on the rent, and short-term loans are sized on the property, your credit and your experience.

Q: How do I get the rehab or construction money?
A: The budget is held back at closing and released in draws as the work is done: you request a draw online, an inspection confirms the progress and the funds go out.

Q: Is there a prepayment penalty?
A: Not on fix and flip, construction or bridge loans. On rental loans you choose, including no penalty.

Q: Can I keep the property as a rental when the work is done?
A: Yes. Once it is rented, refinance into a 30-year DSCR or portfolio loan, qualified on the rent.

Q: Are these hard money loans?
A: They do the same job: short-term, interest-only loans based on the property and the deal. More on hard money loans in California.

Q: Will checking my terms affect my credit score?
A: No. It is a soft pull that does not affect your score.

Q: Which states do you lend in?
A: California, Florida and Texas. For investment property in other states, see West Coast Capital Investment, our investor-lending site for 38 states and Washington, DC. Terms can vary by market, and we confirm what applies to your property on the first call.

## Fix and Flip Loans
URL: https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/fix-and-flip-loans

Up to 90% of the purchase price and 100% of the rehab budget. Short-term, interest-only money to buy and renovate homes you plan to sell or rent.

Key terms:
- Purchase price financed: Up to 90%
- Rehab budget financed: 100%, released in draws
- Loan vs. after-repair value: 70–75% max
- Loan amount: $50K – $3M
- Term: 12 months, interest only 18–24 months for additions and ADUs
- Prepayment penalty: None
- Credit score: From 660 680 for first-time investors
- First flip: Yes, with 680+ credit

Questions and answers:
Q: Can I get a loan for my first flip?
A: Yes. First-time investors can get up to 90% of the price plus 100% of a light or moderate rehab, depending on credit. Licensed agents and contractors start with experience credit.

Q: How much do I need to put down?
A: Usually 10% to 25% of the price, plus closing costs. The rehab is financed at 100%.

Q: What credit score do I need?
A: From 660, or 680 for first-time investors.

Q: Do I pay interest on the whole loan?
A: No. On loans of $100,000 or more you pay interest only on the money drawn.

Q: How do I get the rehab or construction money?
A: The budget is held back at closing and released in draws as the work is done: you request a draw online, an inspection confirms the progress and the funds go out.

Q: Is there a prepayment penalty?
A: No. Pay it off whenever you sell or refinance.

Q: Can I refinance a flip that is already underway?
A: Yes, for experienced investors with a project that is at least half done.

Q: Can I finance a wholesale deal?
A: Yes, with an assignment fee of up to 20% of the price.

Q: What properties can I flip with this loan?
A: Single-family homes, townhomes and small multi-unit properties, from cosmetic updates to full gut renovations, plus additions and ADUs for experienced investors.

Q: Can I keep the property as a rental when the work is done?
A: Yes. Once it is rented, refinance into a 30-year DSCR or portfolio loan, qualified on the rent.

Q: Do I need an LLC or corporation?
A: Yes, the loan closes in your LLC or corporation. No entity yet? Set one up before closing.

Q: Which states do you lend in?
A: California, Florida and Texas. For investment property in other states, see West Coast Capital Investment, our investor-lending site for 38 states and Washington, DC. Terms can vary by market, and we confirm what applies to your property on the first call.

## Ground-Up Construction Loans
URL: https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/ground-up-construction-loans

Land plus 100% of the construction budget for builders putting up new homes, with up to six months of interest built into the loan.

Key terms:
- Land or purchase price: Up to 75% with approved permits
- Construction budget: 100%, released in draws
- Total project cost: Up to 85% 90% with financed interest
- Loan vs. completed value: 70% max
- Loan amount: $50K – $3M
- Term: 12 months, interest only 18–24 months available
- Credit score: From 660 680 for newer builders

Questions and answers:
Q: Can I get a construction loan before permits are approved?
A: Yes. The loan covers 60% of the land now and goes up to 75% once permits are issued.

Q: How much cash do I need to build?
A: Usually from 15% of the total project cost, or 10% when interest is financed, plus closing costs.

Q: Can I include interest in the loan?
A: Yes, up to six months of interest can be built into the loan.

Q: How long is the term?
A: 12 months, interest only, with 18 to 24 months available and extensions if the build runs long.

Q: Do you finance lot splits and more than one home?
A: Yes. A loan can cover two homes, including a lot split, and experienced builders can finance larger developments.

Q: Can I refinance land I already own?
A: Yes, in many cases, including land you bought before getting permits.

Q: How do I get the rehab or construction money?
A: The budget is held back at closing and released in draws as the work is done: you request a draw online, an inspection confirms the progress and the funds go out.

Q: What can I build with a ground-up loan?
A: New single-family homes, townhomes, small multi-unit buildings and condo projects on infill lots, including teardowns and lot splits.

Q: Can I keep the property as a rental when the work is done?
A: Yes. Once it is rented, refinance into a 30-year DSCR or portfolio loan, qualified on the rent.

Q: Do I need an LLC or corporation?
A: Yes, the loan closes in your LLC or corporation. No entity yet? Set one up before closing.

Q: Which states do you lend in?
A: California, Florida and Texas. For investment property in other states, see West Coast Capital Investment, our investor-lending site for 38 states and Washington, DC. Terms can vary by market, and we confirm what applies to your property on the first call.

## Investor Bridge Loans
URL: https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/bridge-loans

For a finished property that’s listed for sale or leasing up. Pay off a rehab loan that’s coming due, or buy a finished home quickly.

Key terms:
- Loan vs. as-is value: Up to 70%
- Loan vs. your cost: Up to 90% homes bought in the last 6 months
- Loan amount: $50K – $3M
- Term: 12 months, interest only extension up to 6 months for a fee
- Cash-flow test: None on renovated homes
- Prepayment penalty: None
- Credit score: From 660 680 for newer investors

Questions and answers:
Q: When does a bridge loan make sense?
A: When a finished flip or new build is listed but not sold, a rehab loan is coming due, or a rental is leasing up before its long-term loan.

Q: Can a bridge loan pay off my current hard money loan?
A: Yes, when the project is finished.

Q: How is the loan sized for a property that is listed for sale?
A: On the lower of the list price and the appraised value, or on your cost if you bought it in the last six months.

Q: Is a DSCR required?
A: Not for renovated homes. Other properties need a 1.10 DSCR.

Q: Do I need experience?
A: Not for renovated homes.

Q: What credit score do I need?
A: From 660, or 680 for newer investors.

Q: What happens after the bridge loan?
A: Sell the property, or refinance into a long-term DSCR or portfolio loan once it is rented. There is no prepayment penalty.

Q: Do I need an LLC or corporation?
A: Yes, the loan closes in your LLC or corporation. No entity yet? Set one up before closing.

Q: How fast can you close?
A: As fast as the appraisal and title allow. We order both right after the pre-screen.

Q: Which states do you lend in?
A: California, Florida and Texas. For investment property in other states, see West Coast Capital Investment, our investor-lending site for 38 states and Washington, DC. Terms can vary by market, and we confirm what applies to your property on the first call.

## Rental Portfolio Loans
URL: https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/rental-portfolio-loans

Two to ten rentals under one 30-year loan. One closing, one payment, qualified on the rent instead of your personal income.

Key terms:
- Properties: 2–10 in one blanket loan
- Loan amount: Up to $2M total
- Purchase or rate-and-term: Up to 80% LTV
- Cash-out refinance: Up to 75% LTV
- DSCR minimum: 1.05 gross rent divided by the monthly payment
- Term: 30 years fixed, ARM or interest-only
- Income documents: None no tax returns, W-2s or pay stubs
- Credit score: From 660 700+ for 80% LTV

Questions and answers:
Q: Can I mix property types in one portfolio loan?
A: Yes. Single-family homes, 2–4 unit properties, townhomes, PUDs and condos can be combined in one loan.

Q: Can I sell one property later?
A: Yes. Pay 120% of the loan amount allocated to that property and it is released.

Q: Is there a prepayment penalty?
A: You choose: five, four, three or one year, or no penalty.

Q: What credit score do I need?
A: From 660, or 700 for 80% LTV.

Q: Do the rentals need to be leased?
A: Yes. At least 90% of the units should be leased, on 12- to 36-month leases.

Q: How much cash do I need in reserve?
A: Closing costs plus three months of payments for a purchase, or six months for a refinance.

Q: When can I do a cash-out refinance?
A: After 90 days of ownership.

Q: Can foreign nationals get a portfolio loan?
A: Yes, up to 65% LTV.

Q: I only have one rental. Which loan fits?
A: A single-property DSCR loan. Portfolio loans start at two properties.

Q: Do I need an LLC or corporation?
A: Yes, the loan closes in your LLC or corporation. No entity yet? Set one up before closing.

Q: Which states do you lend in?
A: California, Florida and Texas. For investment property in other states, see West Coast Capital Investment, our investor-lending site for 38 states and Washington, DC. Terms can vary by market, and we confirm what applies to your property on the first call.

## Multifamily Bridge Loans
URL: https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/multifamily-bridge-loans

Buy, renovate and stabilize a 5+ unit apartment building in California, then refinance into long-term agency financing.

Key terms:
- Loan amount: $2M – $5M one property per loan
- Purchase price: Up to 75%
- Renovation budget: 100%, through a holdback
- Total project cost: Up to 80%
- Term: 18–24 months, interest only plus two 6-month extensions
- As-stabilized value: 70% LTV max
- Once stabilized: 1.25x DSCR and a 9% debt yield
- Credit score: 725+

Questions and answers:
Q: What is the exit for a multifamily bridge loan?
A: A refinance into long-term agency financing once the property is stabilized.

Q: How many units do I need?
A: Five or more, in a fully residential building.

Q: What experience do I need?
A: Experience owning and operating apartment buildings in the same market.

Q: What are the borrower requirements?
A: A single-purpose LLC or corporation, 725+ credit for each member and liquidity of 10% of the loan after closing.

Q: What renovations can be financed?
A: Light to moderate value-add work, up to about half of the purchase price.

Q: How does prepayment work?
A: You can pay off at any time; a minimum of 12 months of interest is due at payoff.

Q: Where can I use a multifamily bridge loan?
A: Apartment buildings in California’s primary and secondary markets.

Q: What due diligence is required?
A: A commercial appraisal, environmental and property condition reports, a budget review and a site visit.

## Hard Money Loans in California
URL: https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/hard-money-loans

Short-term private money for California real estate investors: buy, fix, build or bridge a property, with the loan closed in your LLC. Also available in Florida and Texas.

Key terms:
- Programs: Fix and flip, bridge and ground-up construction plus rental refinances
- Purchase price financed: Up to 90% fix and flip
- Rehab or construction budget: 100%, released in draws
- Loan vs. after-repair value: 70–75% max fix and flip
- Loan amount: $50K – $3M
- Term: 12 months, interest only no prepayment penalty
- Credit score: From 660 680 for first-time investors
- Where: Statewide in California also Florida and Texas
- Borrower: LLC or corporation

Questions and answers:
Q: Who offers hard money loans in Los Angeles?
A: West Coast Capital Mortgage in Los Angeles offers hard money loans across Los Angeles County and the rest of California, plus Florida and Texas: fix and flip, bridge and construction loans.

Q: Is private money the same as hard money?
A: In practice, yes: short-term, interest-only loans based on the property and the deal.

Q: How much can I borrow with a hard money loan?
A: Up to 90% of the price plus 100% of the rehab on a flip, 75% of the land plus 100% of the build on new construction, and 70% of value on a bridge loan, from $50,000 to $3 million.

Q: Can I get a hard money loan for my first flip in California?
A: Yes. First-time investors can get up to 90% of the price plus 100% of a light or moderate rehab, depending on credit.

Q: What credit score do I need for a hard money loan?
A: From 660, or 680 for first-time investors.

Q: Do you check my income for a hard money loan?
A: No personal income verification. The loan is sized on the property, your credit and your experience.

Q: Are you licensed in California?
A: Yes: California DRE Corporation License #02440065 and NMLS #2817729.

Q: What does a hard money loan cost?
A: A rate and origination points set per deal, plus third-party costs. You see everything in a written term sheet before you pay for an appraisal.

Q: How fast can you close?
A: As fast as the appraisal and title allow. We order both right after the pre-screen.

Q: How do I get the rehab or construction money?
A: The budget is held back at closing and released in draws as the work is done: you request a draw online, an inspection confirms the progress and the funds go out.

Q: Do I need an LLC or corporation?
A: Yes, the loan closes in your LLC or corporation. No entity yet? Set one up before closing.

Q: Which states do you lend in?
A: California, Florida and Texas. For investment property in other states, see West Coast Capital Investment, our investor-lending site for 38 states and Washington, DC. Terms can vary by market, and we confirm what applies to your property on the first call.
